summary: community.routeros api_info and api_modify can no longer disable several tool netwatch parameters, name-format in interface wifi provisioning, or script in ip dhcp-client.
questions: Why can't I disable script on ip dhcp-client with api_modify?
Which RouterOS parameters can no longer be disabled?

answer_card.title: RouterOS parameters that can't be disabled
answer_card.answer_md:
With `api_info` and `api_modify`, these can no longer be disabled:

- multiple parameters in `tool netwatch`
- `name-format` in `interface wifi provisioning`
- `script` in `ip dhcp-client`
